about: Phrasing-robustness check for the public samples. The paraphrases were written before any result was seen; the first of each set is the sample's own text and the tumbler set includes the landing page's 'vacuum sealed' phrasing. A paraphrase passes when the answer lands on the expected heading. The bicycle headlight was a public sample until it was replaced by the down sleeping bag (the classifier in use gets its heading wrong); its paraphrases stay here as a known weakness, and the sleeping bag's were written before any of them was run.
